QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the energy associated with third orbit of He⁺.

Solution.S:
For a hydrogen-like atom (He⁺, Z = 2), the energy of the nth orbit is given by:

$$E_n = -\frac{Z^2 R_H}{n^2}$$

where $R_H = 2.18 \times 10^{-18}$ J.

For n = 3:

$$E_3 = -\frac{(2)^2 \times 2.18 \times 10^{-18}}{(3)^2} = -\frac{4 \times 2.18 \times 10^{-18}}{9}$$

$$= -\frac{8.72 \times 10^{-18}}{9} = -0.968 \times 10^{-18} = -9.68 \times 10^{-19} \text{ J}$$

Rounding gives $-9.69 \times 10^{-19}$ J, which corresponds to option D.
